content.value_statement: Agent teams need reliable ways to measure quality, regressions, and context changes. This skill guides rubrics, test sets, judge prompts, and evaluation pipelines.
actual_capabilities: Defines multidimensional rubrics for accuracy, completeness, citations, source quality, and tool efficiency.
Explains test set stratification across simple, medium, complex, and very complex tasks.
Describes LLM-as-judge and human review methods for agent outputs.
Guides continuous evaluation pipelines with baselines, thresholds, and trend tracking.
Connects evaluation to context engineering choices and degradation testing.
limitations: Does not provide executable evaluation framework files.
Does not include runnable scripts or automated tests.
Requires users to define project-specific ground truth and scoring weights.
Does not validate live production telemetry by itself.

use_cases.title: Create Release Quality Gates
use_cases.description: Define pass thresholds and regression checks before shipping agent changes.

use_cases.title: Compare Agent Configurations
use_cases.description: Measure quality, token usage, and tool efficiency across prompt and model variants.

use_cases.title: Review Production Behavior
use_cases.description: Plan sampled reviews, dashboards, and alerts for ongoing agent quality monitoring.

prompt_templates.title: Define Basic Metrics
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new agent evaluation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me define evaluation dimensions for an agent that handles [task]. Include accuracy, completeness, efficiency, and pass criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Test Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning for representative test coverage.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a test set plan for [agent type]. Include simple, medium, complex, and very complex cases with expected outcomes.

prompt_templates.title: Design Judge Instructions
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft LLM-as-judge instructions for evaluating [agent output]. Include scoring levels, evidence requirements, and failure conditions.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Continuous Evaluation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced production monitoring and regression control.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a continuous evaluation pipeline for [agent system]. Include baselines, sampling, dashboards, alerts, and release gates.

output_examples.input: Evaluate a research agent for citation quality and answer completeness.
output_examples.output: A rubric with citation accuracy, source quality, factual accuracy, completeness, and process quality dimensions.

output_examples.input: Compare two agent prompts before release.
output_examples.output: A comparison plan with shared test cases, weighted scoring, token tracking, and regression thresholds.
A monitoring approach using sampled conversations, human review, trend dashboards, and alerts for quality drops.

best_practices: Evaluate outcomes instead of requiring one fixed execution path.
Use multiple quality dimensions with clear scoring levels and weights.
Combine automated judging with human review for edge cases.
anti_patterns: Using one accuracy score for every agent behavior.
Testing only simple prompts that do not match real usage.
Changing prompts without keeping baseline evaluation results.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps design evaluation frameworks for agent systems, including rubrics, test sets, judge prompts, and monitoring plans.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance is tool agnostic and applies to Claude, Codex, Claude Code, and similar agent workflows.

faq.question: Does it include executable code?
faq.answer: No. It provides methodology and examples, but users must implement their own evaluation tooling.

faq.question: How should I handle non-deterministic agent behavior?
faq.answer: Judge whether the final outcome is correct and whether the process is reasonable, instead of requiring identical steps.

faq.question: When should human review be added?
faq.answer: Use human review for edge cases, high-risk decisions, unusual failures, and samples from production traffic.

faq.question: What should I measure over time?
faq.answer: Track quality scores, pass rates, token usage, tool efficiency, regressions, and trends across model or prompt versions.
